A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed the tools to measure BBB transport, have developed a knowledge base in BBB biology, and have begun to apply these tools to the development of CNS drug delivery systems.
there is a need to understand the BBB, but there is also a need to understand how to get drugs into the CNS.

the BBB can be overcome.
